lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: # Comprehende — implementation plan

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: Product intent lives in [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md). This file is the working plan: locked decisions, what shipped, and what is left.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: **Shipped:** phases 0–4 (CLI, schema, live git, UI). **Left:**

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 1. [#2](https://github.com/matemolnar8/comprehende/issues/2) npm-publishable package (before the skill is finalized)

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 2. [#3](https://github.com/matemolnar8/comprehende/issues/3) skill reviewed and rewritten by hand (Máté)

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 3. [#4](https://github.com/matemolnar8/comprehende/issues/4) test against personal repos

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 4. [#5](https://github.com/matemolnar8/comprehende/issues/5) drill-down convenience — open, no design yet

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Locked decisions

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: Unchanged.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Distribution:** hybrid. Agent Skill for the review workflow; npm CLI (`comprehende`) for git I/O and the local UI.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - **Package name:** `comprehende` (unscoped). GitHub repo is public. Install skill with `npx skills add matemolnar8/comprehende`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **UI stack:** Vite + React + TypeScript.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Hunk ownership:** a hunk may appear in multiple groups. Coverage still requires every git hunk to appear in at least one group.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **Diff source of truth:** git, live, at serve time. The review document must not contain patch text or file contents.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - **CLI cwd:** the CLI is run inside the repository under review. Repo path defaults to the current working directory. Do not snapshot the repo into the review document.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: npm publish is how the CLI is distributed (`npx comprehende`). That is not a hosted app. The review UI still runs only on localhost against git in cwd.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Architecture

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Two artifacts from one repo:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: human ── /comprehende ──► agent skill

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ├─ 1. comprehende index   (git hunk index, no patch text)

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ├─ 2. write review.json    (groups + summaries + hunk refs)

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ├─ 3. comprehende validate

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: └─ 4. comprehende serve --data review.json

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: │  cwd = the repo

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: local UI

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - **Skill** (`skills-next/comprehende/` to edit, `skills/comprehende/` for `npx skills add`): when to run, grouping rules, schema, “never invent diffs,” launch commands. Distributed via `npx skills add`. **Máté reviews and rewrites this by hand** before it is treated as final. See remaining work.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - **CLI** (`comprehende` on npm): talks to git in cwd, validates the review document, serves the SPA + git-backed APIs.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: Once the package is publishable, the skill should call `npx comprehende@<pinned>` so the UI is not stuffed into the skill folder (size limits, versioning, long-running server). Today the skill still tells agents to use a built binary, `pnpm dev`, or a global link.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ### Why the CLI owns git

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: The UI is a projector. If review JSON carried hunk lines, that copy could drift from the repo, and we would have failed the accuracy goal. Serve-time git means:

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Diffs, full files, blame, and commit metadata are always `git` output from the repo the CLI was started in.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `review.json` is only interpretation: what to look at, in what order, and why.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Opening a review of repo A while cwd is repo B is a user error; the CLI should refuse if `source` refs don’t resolve.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: Patches shown in the UI are **slices of live `git diff` stdout** (file header + selected hunk bytes). The CLI does not reconstruct unified patches from parsed fields.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Review document

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: JSON is pointers and prose. No unified diff, no file bodies, no blame.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: Shipped document shape (extras beyond the original sketch are marked):

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ```ts

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: type ReviewDocument = {

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: version: 1

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: source: {

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: baseRef: string

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: headRef: string

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: range?: string

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: size: "trivial" | "small" | "medium" | "large" | "very-large" // human review burden, not file count

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: title: string // short name of the whole change

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: summary: string // short what of the whole change

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: why?: string // generated why, from sources

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: sources?: Source[] // locators the skill read, plus gist

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: groups: ReviewGroup[]

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: type ReviewGroup = {

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: id: string

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: title: string

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: why: string // why this group exists

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: summary: string // one sentence: what this group is

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: lookFor?: string[] // scannable inspect list

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: dependsOn?: string[] // earlier group ids, same story only

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: part?: string // story name

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: sources?: string[] // source ids

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: suggestedOrder: number

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: hunkRefs: HunkRef[]

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: type HunkRef = {

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: path: string

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: oldPath?: string

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: oldStart: number

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: oldLines: number

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: newStart: number

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: newLines: number

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: `HunkRef` matches a `git diff` hunk header (`@@ -oldStart,oldLines +newStart,newLines @@`) plus path. Identity is `(path, oldStart, newStart)` (include `oldPath` when renamed). Additional properties are rejected so patch text cannot sneak in.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Index vs document:** `comprehende index` prints the current hunk list for the agent (paths + @@ ranges, still no line content). The agent assigns those refs to groups. `comprehende serve` re-runs `git diff` in cwd and joins by `HunkRef`. The index is a helper for the agent, not something the UI stores.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Coverage:** every hunk in the live `git diff` of `source.baseRef...source.headRef` must be referenced by ≥1 group. Unreferenced hunks are a validation error and an “unassigned” bucket in the UI. Duplicate refs across groups are allowed.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: **Stale refs:** if a `HunkRef` does not match a live hunk (rebase, uncommitted edit), serve still shows the live git diff and flags the broken pointer. Git wins. Do not invent a replacement hunk.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: **Drill-down** is CLI APIs against cwd, not fields in JSON: full file (`git show`), blame (`git blame --line-porcelain`), log, rename detection. The document may list sources; the UI renders `label` / `url` / `title` / `gist` from the document. It does not fetch a host. Host CLIs are never required.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: Drill-down **works** (file inspector, blame inspector, commit list on Overview, header refs/SHAs). Convenience of that drill-down is an open product question — no design yet.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## CLI surface (v1)

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Run inside the target repo.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: comprehende index  [--base <ref>] [--head <ref>]

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: comprehende validate --data <review.json>

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: comprehende serve --data <review.json> [--port] [--open]

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: comprehende export --data <review.json> --out <dir>

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - `base` / `head` default to `origin/HEAD` (fallback `main` / `master`) … `HEAD`. Override via flags or `source` in the JSON.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - `serve` binds `127.0.0.1` only. It re-reads git on every request; it does not cache patch text in the document.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `export` writes the same UI plus frozen git payloads to `--out` dir for static hosting. No git in that folder.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - No `--repo` flag in v1. Cwd is the repo. If cwd is not a git work tree, exit with an error.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## UI (shipped)

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Fixed chrome, data-driven. Group-first, not file-alphabet-first.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Left: review **stack** — Overview, then groups in `suggestedOrder`, then Unassigned. Groups show `lookFor` and `dependsOn`.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Center: live hunks for the selected group (from git, joined by `hunkRefs`). Unified and split (50/50, resizable). Wrap toggle. Hunk headers from git ranges, not invented `@@` prose.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Secondary: file tree derived from the live diff; full file / blame as drill-down inspectors.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Visible **unassigned** hunks so coverage failures cannot hide.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Diffs, full files, and blame are painted with [`@pierre/diffs`](https://diffs.com) from live git text. The browser never computes diffs.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: The original plan said “unified first; split later.” Split shipped. Syntax highlight is Pierre/Shiki, not a custom table.

lines.author: matemolnar8

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - AI-generated or “cleaned up” patches

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - IDE extension, PR comment posting

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - GitHub review threads / CI checks clone

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - `--repo` pointing at a path other than cwd

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: ## Build order

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: | Phase | Intent | What actually shipped |

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: | 0. Plan | This file + `AGENTS.md` | Kept; this revision actualizes it |

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: | 1. Skeleton | LICENSE, pnpm, stub CLI/skill | Done |

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: | 2. Schema + git index | Types, `index` / `validate`, fixture (rename, multi-hunk, binary skip) | Done. Index has no line content. Coverage and extra/missing refs fail validate |

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: | 3. Serve + UI | Groups / live hunks / file tree; fixture serve | Done |

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: | 4. Diff viewer + file browser | Unified, highlight, wrap, group filter, `git show`; blame and commits next | Done, then exceeded: Pierre renderer, split view, blame inspector, commit list, stack chrome |

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: Unit tests cover index, validate, coverage, stale refs, and HTTP smoke (`serve` fixture, git join). Playwright was “later, fixture only” and is **not** the next milestone.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ### Prerequisite to 5 — npm-publishable package

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: Done mechanically. `prepack` builds CLI + UI; UI libraries are `devDependencies`; `pnpm pack:smoke` installs the tarball in a foreign cwd and runs `index` / `validate` / `serve`. README uses `npx comprehende@0.6.1`. CI publishes from `main` when `package.json` version is new.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: First npm publish (unscoped name `comprehende`, account, trusted publisher for workflow `ci.yml`) is Máté’s. Until that exists, CI skips publish.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: Issue: [#2](https://github.com/matemolnar8/comprehende/issues/2)

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ### 5. Skill — review and rewrite by hand (Máté)

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: Not an agent rewrite. The current `skills-next/comprehende/` is a working draft so the loop could be dogfooded. **Máté reviews it and rewrites it by hand.** `pnpm release:skill` copies it to `skills/comprehende/` for `npx skills add`.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: Keep `SKILL.md` under 500 lines; the JSON Schema lives in `skills-next/comprehende/references/review.schema.json` (copied from `src/schema/review.schema.json` by `pnpm sync:skill`). Example stays in `references/example.md`. Pin `npx comprehende@<version>` once the prerequisite exists.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: #### Differences vs the original plan (and vs this draft)

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: These are the deltas to resolve in the rewrite — not a request to keep or drop them blindly.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 1. **How the agent invokes the CLI.** Plan: `npx comprehende@<pinned>`. Draft: `node /path/to/comprehende/dist/cli/main.js`, `pnpm dev` only when this repo is under review, or `pnpm link --global`. That is checkout-era. The rewrite should assume a published package.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: 2. **Who writes `review.json`.** Locked: the agent writes groups from `index` output after reading the live git diffs. `comprehende generate` is removed. Path-heuristic drafts are not a substitute for concern-based grouping.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 3. **Summary contract.** Plan: “Summaries say what changed and why it matters. Do not paraphrase the patch.” Draft: `summary` is **one sentence** (intent of the group); `lookFor` is bullets of what to inspect; optional document `walkthrough` is one or two sentences for Overview. The UI is built around that split. The rewrite should either adopt it as the contract or change the product.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 4. **Reading order.** Plan: prose rule — contracts / foundations, then call sites, then tests, then chores. Draft: same idea encoded as `dependsOn` plus a stack Overview. Confirm that is the grouping model, not directory-first.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 5. **Schema extras.** `walkthrough`, `lookFor`, `dependsOn` are in the shipped schema and UI. They were not in the original PLAN types. Keep, rename, or drop in the hand rewrite — the JSON Schema must match whatever you write. Canonical file: `src/schema/review.schema.json`. `pnpm sync:skill` copies it into `skills-next/comprehende/references/` and mirrors that skill tree into `.agents/skills/comprehende/`. `pnpm release:skill` copies next onto `skills/comprehende/`. Tests fail if next drifts from the CLI contract. Do not maintain a separate `schema.md`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: 6. **Host recipe.** Draft had a GitHub `git fetch origin pull/<n>/head` snippet and optional `gh pr view`. The skill is vendor-agnostic (GitHub, Bitbucket, local branches). Three-dot `base...head` is the request diff. Tickets may live on the document; host CLIs are never required.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 7. **Install story.** Plan: `npx skills add matemolnar8/comprehende` from the public repo. Draft skill does not mention `skills add`. README already splits checkout install vs “once published.” The rewrite should describe the published install only.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 8. **Dogfood target.** Original phase 5 said “dogfood on this repo.” That is now phase 6 (personal repos). This repo can still be a fixture; it is not the definition of done for the skill.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 9. **Preserve.** Accuracy rules in the draft match the plan and should stay: never copy patch text into `review.json`; git wins on stale refs; refuse unresolved `source`; cwd is the repo; no `--repo`; UI is a projector.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: Issue: [#3](https://github.com/matemolnar8/comprehende/issues/3) (blocked on [#2](https://github.com/matemolnar8/comprehende/issues/2))

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ### 6. Test against personal repos

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: Definition of done for “does this work” is running the CLI (and, after 5, the skill) against Máté’s real repositories — not Playwright, not only `fixtures/repo`.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: Known candidates already in the README: [vitadeck](https://github.com/matemolnar8/vitadeck) (public) and cigster (private). Use whatever repos are actually under review; those are examples, not a closed list.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: What to learn:

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - `index` / `validate` / `serve` on real three-dot ranges (including GitHub PR diffs).

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Grouping quality if an agent writes the document: coverage, stale refs after rebase, multi-hunk files, renames, binaries.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Whether drill-down is usable enough on real files to live with until there is a design.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: After npm publish, re-run the same loop via `npx comprehende@<pinned>` so we are not only testing the checkout.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: Issue: [#4](https://github.com/matemolnar8/comprehende/issues/4)

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ### Open — drill-down convenience

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: Full file, blame, and commits exist. They need to be easier to use. There is no design yet. Do not invent a UX. Capture pain from phase 6 (jumping from a hunk into the surrounding file, blame vs a separate inspector, commit list vs hunk, ticket links) and come back.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: Issue: [#5](https://github.com/matemolnar8/comprehende/issues/5)

lines.author: Cursor Agent
